run_wav2vec2_asr_evaluation: run the wav2vec2 ASR evaluation recipe using the eval_main CLI entry point
run_eval_recipe_cli: run the Wav2Vec2AsrEvalRecipe via the __main__ module to evaluate a wav2vec2 ASR model
run_wer_evaluation: run word error rate evaluation on a wav2vec2 ASR model using the eval recipe
run_librispeech_eval: run the wav2vec2 ASR evaluation recipe on the LibriSpeech test_clean split
run_eval_with_config: run the wav2vec2 ASR evaluation recipe with a custom config file for model and dataset settings
